verified_apis.api: tkinter.PhotoImage(file=local path); width(); height(); get(x, y)

no_api_findings.runtime: CPython 3.13.1 generic byte and compression APIs
no_api_findings.finding: zlib decompresses generic streams, struct unpacks caller-specified layouts, and file APIs supply bytes. None interprets PNG chunks or pixels by itself. imghdr was removed in Python 3.13 and earlier identified file types only.

limit: Tkinter PhotoImage requires a Tk installation and a usable GUI session. The positive result is for bundled Tk 8.6 on this macOS host; other Python distributions may omit Tk or have different Tk versions.
